name: Face Analysis
description: A round-the-clock audience analyst for your store: builds hourly visitor profiles by gender and age group and reads emotional feedback, informing product selection, displays and campaigns. Analysis stays on the device — no face images leave the camera.
description_zh: 为门店配一位全天候“客群统计员”：自动统计进店顾客的性别与年龄段构成，感知情绪反馈，形成分时段客群画像，为选品、陈列和活动策划提供依据。全程端侧分析，人脸影像不出设备，天生照顾隐私合规。
author: Seeed Studio
